text: CDT (CDT Equipamentos Desportivos, Lda, Vila Nova de Famalicão) was created in 2012 by businessman Bruno Salgado; a profile published by the municipality describes him as the entrepreneur behind the company.
short: CDT was created by entrepreneur Bruno Salgado in 2012.

source.name: Famalicão Made IN (Câmara Municipal de Vila Nova de Famalicão): CDT na primeira liga dos equipamentos desportivos
source.quote: A CDT, criada em 2012 por Bruno Salgado
source.note: Translation: 'CDT, created in 2012 by Bruno Salgado'; the profile refers to Salgado as 'o empresário' [the businessman] when quoting him at the inauguration of the company's purpose-built premises.
